default.notes: Apply online through the official DGDI e-Visa portal before travel — the visa is issued on arrival, but only at Libreville Léon-Mba International Airport; other entry points require an embassy-issued visa.

groups.notes: CEMAC citizens enter Gabon freely under the Community’s free-movement arrangements with a valid passport or national ID.
Covered by the visa-exemption measures Gabon announced in late 2023 for short tourist stays — implementation has been uneven, so confirm with the DGDI portal or a Gabonese embassy before travel.
Visa-free for short stays under a bilateral agreement — confirm the permitted duration with a Gabonese embassy before travel.

GA.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Gabonese citizens.
